summary: Sachem Capital Corp. filed an 8-K to report entry into a Contribution Agreement to acquire IRG Master Holdings, LLC from Industrial Realty Group Global, LLC. IRG Global will contribute 100% of the membership interests in exchange for OP Units and shares of Class B common stock. The consideration is equity-based, with no specified price per share or premium. The Sachem Board unanimously approved the transaction. Pre-closing steps include forming an operating partnership, redomesticating to Delaware, and a 20-to-1 reverse stock split. Closing is expected by end of 2026. Investors should monitor regulatory approvals and the successful completion of pre-closing reorganization steps.
